The golden '''eight-pointed star''' ornament is a ''[[ter'angreal]]'' in the possession of [[Cadsuane Melaidhrin]] as a part of her [[paralis-net]].

==Appearance==
An eight-pointed star-shaped trinket, pending from a golden hair needle. It has four long and four short wavy rays

==Use==
The star vibrates in the presence of men who can [[channel]]. The more male channelers that are present, the more the star will vibrate.{{ref/book|10|23}} It can detect the ability of a man to channel within a distance of thirty or forty paces. But it did not identify which man inside that range could channel, only the presence of one.
